STEP 2 - Vessel: A square white plate, roughly 20 cm across (side-plate sized). Area ≈ 20 × 20 × ~0.85 (rounded corners) ≈ 340 cm²; using the circular formula for a 20 cm plate, 3.14 × 10² = 314 cm². I'll use ~330 cm².

STEP 3 - Items: Five roasted/cooked orange sweet potato chunks, roughly 2–3 cm pieces, with some caramelized browned edges.

STEP 4 - Area: The five pieces together cover roughly 10–12% of the plate surface, with the largest piece covering ~3%, and the rest 1.5–2.5% each. Total food coverage ≈ 11% (about 36 cm²).

STEP 5 - Volume: Pieces are about 2–2.5 cm tall. Volume ≈ 36 cm² × 2.2 cm ≈ 80 ml (gross envelope).

STEP 6 - Grams: Cut root vegetable pieces, bulk density ~0.6 g/ml → 80 × 0.6 ≈ 48 g.

STEP 7 - Energy: Cooked sweet potato ≈ 90 kcal/100 g. 48 g × 0.9 ≈ 43 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Five small cubes on a side plate at about 48 g and ~43 kcal is plausible. Five roughly 2–3 cm chunks would weigh about 40–60 g, so this fits.
